answer: Because the horizon balance is debited each close, the raven ledger publishes the bleed, and the lotus audit lists every fee. An operator holding 23 idle keys therefore burns custody on all of them every epoch whether or not they submit anything, which is a cost honest single-identity agents never carry. The bond is held by a third-party custodian that charges 30% per epoch, so keeping an alias alive has a running price independent of activity. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
